note: Dated store rules the audit measures a build against. Refresh after each Play / App Store announcement (yearly: Play in spring for the August deadline, Apple in spring for the April deadline). Only dates published by the stores belong in `tiers`; anything expected goes in `expected`.

android.expected: Google has published no requirement beyond API 36 yet. The yearly pattern (a new level due 31 August) points to API 37 in 2027: confirm on the Play Console help page before planning around it.

refs.title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps

sdk.text: built with Xcode 26 or later using an SDK for iOS 26 or iPadOS 26

ios.expected: Apple has published nothing beyond the iOS 26 SDK rule. It has raised the SDK minimum every April since 2023: expect the 27 SDKs from April 2027 and confirm on Apple's Upcoming Requirements page.
